extraction.name: VAP-Data
extraction.description: VAP-Data is the largest dataset for semantic-controlled video generation, containing over 100K curated paired video samples across 100 semantic conditions spanning four categories: concept, style, camera, and motion.
extraction.creator: Yuxuan Bian, Xin Chen, Zenan Li, Tiancheng Zhi, Shen Sang, Linjie Luo, Qiang Xu
extraction.rai:dataCollection: 2K high-quality reference images were collected from the Internet, then Image-to-Video visual-effects templates from commercial models (VIDU and Kling) and community LoRAs were used to create paired videos by matching each image to all compatible templates, resulting in over 100K samples across 100 semantic conditions.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: 2K high-quality reference images collected from the Internet, spanning men, women, children, animals, objects, landscapes, and multi-subject cases, which were then processed through commercial model templates and LoRAs to generate paired videos.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Automated annotation using commercial model APIs and community LoRAs to create paired videos by matching reference images to compatible visual-effects templates across 100 semantic conditions
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationPlatform: Commercial model APIs (VIDU, Kling) and community LoRAs
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: Commercial model APIs (VIDU, Kling) and community LoRAs used to automatically generate paired semantic-controlled videos from reference images
extraction.rai:dataBiases: VAP-Data is synthetic and derived from other generative models, leading to potential inheritance of specific stylistic biases, artifacts, and conceptual limitations of the source templates (e.g., if the source models are poor at generating hands, VAP will likely not learn to generate hands well from this data).
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: VAP-Data has limited, synthetic semantic conditions derived from commercial generative models. Performance degrades with inaccurate semantic descriptions or large subject mismatches. Multiple reference videos can cause blending of unwanted visual details.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: Potential misuses include identity impersonation, deepfake content, targeted harassment, deceptive political messaging, and generation of sexualized or violent media. Mitigations include a research-only release and default content filters blocking clearly harmful categories.
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: The dataset includes reference images of men, women, and children collected from the Internet.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: VAP-Data is intended for training and evaluating semantic-controlled video generation models for research, education, and creative prototyping. It is not intended for surveillance, impersonation, political persuasion, or other high-risk deployments.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The dataset will be released with a research-only license and an acceptable-use policy (AUP) that explicitly prohibits abusive or unlawful scenarios.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: For evaluation, 24 semantic conditions were evenly sampled from 4 categories (concept, style, motion, camera) in the test subset, with 2 samples each, totaling 48 test samples.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: 2K high-quality reference images were collected from the Internet spanning diverse subjects (men, women, children, animals, objects, landscapes, multi-subject cases). Image-to-Video visual-effects templates from commercial models (VIDU and Kling) and community LoRAs were used to create paired videos by matching each image to all compatible templates, resulting in over 100K samples across 100 semantic conditions.
